name: run_shell
description: Run a noninteractive shell command locally on the user's jailbroken iPhone. Runs as the app user when Root is off, or UID 0 through the local Root service when Root is on. Each call needs user approval. cwd is the selected workspace. Output combines stdout/stderr and is bounded. Shell access is not confined to the workspace. No persistent background jobs. Ask user before consequential system changes.

command.description: Shell command to run using the active jailbreak environment's path rules.

name: read_file
description: Read UTF-8 text from a regular file. Relative paths are resolved in the workspace; absolute paths allowed. Returns a byte offset for the next chunk. Maximum 49152 bytes per read.

name: write_file
description: Atomically write a UTF-8 text file up to 256 KiB. Existing file is backed up first. Relative paths resolve in workspace; absolute paths allowed. Parent directory must exist. Rejects symlinks and nonregular targets. Shell changes are not automatically backed up.

name: list_directory
description: List up to 200 sorted entries of a local directory. Relative paths resolve in workspace; absolute paths allowed.

name: list_remote_devices
description: List paired AsterHand devices (names and device IDs). Local tools affect this iPhone only. Resolve the intended device before remote operations.

name: remote_execute
description: Run a tool on an explicitly paired OTHER device. Allowed tools: run_shell, read_file, write_file, list_directory, screen_capture, screen_tap, screen_swipe, screen_type, screen_home. arguments_json is a JSON object matching the tool arguments. Never forward remote_execute. Capture and inspect before clicking. Do not use this to bypass a rejection.
